summary: Read a grid of 9 rows and 9 columns. Dots mark cells still open, and every other cell already holds a digit from 1 through 9. Fill each open cell with a digit so that every row contains 1 through 9 once each, every column does likewise, and every block of 3 rows by 3 columns does likewise. Exactly one such filling exists. Write the grid after every open cell has been filled.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
